newsitem.title: USA: Anicom says Peter Huizenga joins board.
newsitem.headline: Anicom says Peter Huizenga joins board.

text.p: Anicom Inc, a seller of multimedia wiring products, said Thursday Peter Huizenga, president of Huizenga Capital Management and co-founder of Waste Management Inc, will join its board of directors.
Also joining the board is Thomas Reinman, senior vice president of state and governmental affairs for Ameritech Corp.
The additions bring Anicom's board to 11 members, inclduing six outside directors, the company said.

Also Thursday, Anicom said it completed the sale and issuance of convertible preferred stock in a private placement that raised $27 million before expenses. Proceeds are planned to be used for ongoing acquisitions and general corporate purposes, the company said.
